# Paths that cannot affect the Docker images, the package or the install
# script. When a pull request changes only these paths, CI skips the build,
# package and install jobs. The merge queue always runs them.
#
# One entry per line. An entry ending in "/" matches everything under that
# folder. Any other entry matches that one file exactly. There are no
# wildcards or file type patterns: a new file is built unless it is listed
# here.
#
# CI fails if an entry overlaps a path that build-scripts/package/package.py
# packages or that a Dockerfile copies, or if a listed folder contains a
# folder named "locale", which compilemessages would compile.

docs/
agents/
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md
CONTRIBUTING.md
DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md
SECURITY.md
TROUBLESHOOTING.md
README.md
